options.description: Keep today's limits, compact the logs first (part of this build's landing), then measure again and set the limits from that second profile. Slower to settle; the limits reflect the fixed system, not the bloated logs.
options.label: Keep 60/90 s, re-profile (Recommended)

options.description: Set limits from this profile: about 3 min for session start, 1.7 min for messages and turn end, 6 min hard limit. Hooks rarely get cut, but a slow hook can stall you for minutes.
options.label: Apply the rule now

options.description: Ignore cold-cache runs: about 65 s / 33 s / 65 s budgets and a 130 s hard limit. Cold starts after a cache reset may still be cut.
options.label: Warm times only

options.description: Short limits for end of turn and edits, long ones for session start and messages. Fits each hook, but adds one setting per hook.
options.label: Per-hook hard limits

payload.question: Measured on this repository, hooks take far longer than planned: start of session up to 93 s, each message up to 50 s, end of turn up to 52 s (a warm end of turn alone is now 5–7 s). The logs are still uncompacted and the machine was busy. Your rule (limit = measured time with headroom) would give limits of 1.5–6 minutes. What should the hook limits be?
